source.title: Mars Viking Colorized Global Mosaic 232m (MDIM 2.1)
source.credit: USGS Astrogeology Science Center / NASA Ames / Viking Orbiter

processing: USGS WMS MDIM21_color global map exported at 1024x512 JPEG, EPSG:4326, without project recoloring; immutable SHA-256-bound copy.
limitations: NASA Ames artistically colorized the Viking MDIM 2.1 mosaic; this is historical cartography, not natural-color or current Mars photography.
The 1024x512 WMS/JPEG resample limits detail; the shader's simple phase mask is not calibrated surface photometry or atmospheric scattering.
